title: cyanus atratus
intro: Cyanus atratus, commonly known as Cornflower, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion tribe of the sunflower family, native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cornflower are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit calming and antispasmodic effects. In herbal medicine, Cornflower is used to treat conditions such as eczema, allergies, and insomnia, due to its soothing and sedative properties.
